description: Enhance Mobility And Connectivity Goal 4 Dataset is a series of datasets listed in St. Louis County open data portal (impact.stlouisco.com), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by St. Louis County. Coverage: St. Louis County, Missouri. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The table has 10 columns. The portal shows 2016-10-27 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-impact-stlouisco-com-portal.
